FROM THE CLINIC BLOG

Dental care, explained.

Practical topics from The Lady Dentist’s Instagram, with the original posts alongside each guide.

Daily care

Floss or toothpick?

The clinic explains how toothpicks can irritate gums and why it recommends floss for cleaning between teeth.

Read the guide

When food gets stuck between teeth, a toothpick can press into the gum. In its explainer, the clinic suggests using dental floss to clear the space. If food repeatedly gets caught in the same spot or floss is hard to use, bring that up at your next checkup.

Watch the explainer

Family dentistry

When a child’s teeth come in crooked

Dr. Asma discusses early checkups and habits parents can bring up during a dental visit.

Read the guide

Notice when the change began and mention any ongoing habits, such as thumb sucking, at the checkup. The dentist can look at how the teeth and bite are developing and explain whether to monitor the changes or schedule a follow-up.

Watch the explainer

Inside the practice

Before your first visit

See the treatment rooms and the team at work before you visit.

Read the guide

Think about what you’d like to discuss and bring any questions about the exam, treatment choices, and costs. If you’re visiting for the first time, use the clinic’s Google Maps pin and look for the location opposite Iqbal High School.
